title: Sharp existence conditions and geometric inheritance for overdetermined free boundary problems of Laplacian and bi-Laplacian type
summary: This paper provides necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of free boundaries in overdetermined problems for the Laplacian, and sufficient conditions for the bi-Laplacian, when the overdetermined boundary condition is non-constant. Using classical integral inequalities (Cauchy-Schwarz, Hölder, Hardy, eigenvalue bounds, Pohozaev and Reilly identities), we derive existence results for a broad class of free boundary problems arising in potential theory, plate theory, electromagnetism, and shape optimization. A regularity result for minimizers in the $C$-GNP class is established…
